description:
Account book of Yeshuaʿ b. Ismāʿīl al-Makhmūrī containing payment orders. Dating: ca. 1048 (Gil). (Information from Gil)

NB: in l. 11 below, it is probably better to read "ilā l-Qāḍī al-Qulzum" (the qāḍī of the Red Sea) instead of al-Qalūs (information from Oded Zinger). In either reading, there is a non-standard iḍāfa (relatively common in Judaeo-Arabic).
description_he: ספר חשבונות של ישוע ב' ישמעאל אל-מח'מורי הכולל פקודות תשלום. תאריך משוער: 1048 לספירה (גיל).
